officialSearch.boundaryNote: Accepted as a coarse official search ingress and normalized onto the same search toggle path as `deepseek_options.search`; `search_context_size` and `user_location` remain hint-only fields rather than full-fidelity browser controls.

officialReasoning.boundaryNote: `reasoning_effort=none` maps to `deep_think=off`; `minimal|low|medium|high|xhigh` all map to `deep_think=on` because the current DeepSeek surface only exposes a binary DeepThink toggle.

officialSearch.boundaryNote: At most one official `web_search_preview*` tool is accepted and normalized onto the same search toggle path as `deepseek_options.search`; `search_context_size` and `user_location` remain hint-only fields, `search_content_types` only accepts `[text]`, and richer tool orchestration semantics remain out of scope.

officialReasoning.boundaryNote: `reasoning` object presence maps to `deep_think=on`, while `reasoning.effort=none` maps to `deep_think=off`; the effort ladder is many-to-one, and `reasoning.summary` / `generate_summary` remain rejected because they cannot be truthfully mapped.

extension.fallbackNote: `deepseek_options.search|deep_think` remains an extension/fallback surface only; it shares the same normalized toggle path as the official ingress and is not a second execution path.

explicitReject: unknown nested fields under official control ingress
